design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Even though VIN handles 28 V (30 V abs max), EN (Pin 5) is rated ONLY to 5.5 V recommended / 7.0 V abs max! Connecting EN directly to a 12 V or 24 V bus (as allowed on TPS563201 or AP63203) destroys TPS54302 immediately. Float EN to auto-enable or use a precision resistor divider.

design_gotchas.title: Feedback Reference (0.596 V) Differs From Pin-Compatible TPS563201 (0.768 V) and AP62200 (0.800 V)
design_gotchas.detail: TPS54302DDCR shares the exact 6-pin SOT-23/TSOT-23 pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BOOT) with TPS563201DDCR and AP62200WU-7, but its 0.596 V VREF is 22-26% lower. Dropping it into an existing divider without recalculating Rtop/Rbot lowers VOUT by ~25% (or raises VOUT +29-34% if swapping in the opposite direction).

design_gotchas.title: Pinout Mismatch Against AP63203WU-7 Despite Identical 6-Pin TSOT/SOT-23 Body
design_gotchas.detail: Do NOT confuse TPS54302DDCR (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BOOT) with Diodes AP63203WU-7 (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST). Putting one on the other's footprint shorts SW/VIN/GND/FB immediately.

design_gotchas.title: Lower 400 kHz Switching Frequency Requires Larger Inductors (6.8-10 uH) Than 580-1100 kHz Parts
design_gotchas.detail: At 400 kHz (with spread spectrum), TPS54302 requires 6.8 uH (3.3 V) to 10 uH (5 V) inductors, compared to 2.2-3.3 uH on 580 kHz TPS563201 or 750 kHz AP62200. Reusing a 2.2 uH inductor causes excessive ripple current and premature current-limit hiccup.

typical_use_cases: Industrial 12 V and 24 V distributed bus step-down to 5.0 V or 3.3 V at up to 3 A continuous load
EMI-sensitive appliances, audio equipment, and set-top boxes leveraging built-in frequency spread spectrum
Ultra-low-BOM 6-pin synchronous buck upgrade over non-synchronous SOIC-8 TPS54331DR or TO-263 LM2596
engineering_summary: The TPS54302DDCR is a 4.5 V to 28 V input, 3 A continuous synchronous buck converter in SOT-23-6 (DDC) integrating 85 mOhm/40 mOhm MOSFETs, internal compensation, 5 ms soft-start, Eco-mode pulse skip (45 uA Iq), and EMI-friendly 400 kHz spread-spectrum switching (~95% peak efficiency). It is pin-compatible with TPS563201DDCR and AP62200WU-7 (NOT AP63203WU-7), but engineers MUST respect its 7.0 V abs max EN pin limit (float to enable), recalculate feedback resistors for VREF = 0.596 V, and upsize the inductor to 6.8-10 uH; always verify against the official TI datasheet before production.
